front_blocks.md: Explain why taking natural logs of the radioactive decay equation $N = N_{0} e^{-λt}$ produces a straight-line graph.

front_blocks.md: A student records repeat values of angular frequency, *ω*: 0.154, 0.153, 0.159, 0.147, 0.152 rad s<sup>-1</sup>. Calculate the percentage uncertainty in the mean value.

back_blocks.md: Mean *ω* = 0.153 rad s<sup>-1</sup>.
Half the range = ½ × (0.159 − 0.147) = 0.006 rad s<sup>-1</sup>.
Percentage uncertainty = (0.006 ÷ 0.153) × 100% = **3.92%**.
